walls.note: East gable on the Noordermarkt (RCE 20013236 and 20013231, Commons CC BY-SA 4.0; Hnapel photograph CC BY-SA 4.0): the standard gable of all four arms. Panorama 00473 only shows the lean-to and its portal through trees.

items.where: two tall round-headed lights per gable, each a pair of lancets under a rosette head, in a cream arch ring, glazed with white transoms from 6 m up to the 14 m crest
items.how: builder: arch-outline ring with hole, arch glass, mullion, two lancet bars, transoms every 0.62 m, two half tori and one ring for the rosette head, on all four gables

items.where: round quatrefoil window in a cream ring above the windows, centre 18.2 m, diameter 4.3 m
items.how: builder: cream ring, glass disc, four lobe tori, central ring and outer ring in white

items.where: scroll volutes on each gable shoulder either side of the roundel, cream raking coping along the shoulders
items.how: a torus per scroll on a short cream stem plus a straight raking coping box; the spiral is not carved

items.where: gable crowned by a balustrade with ball urns and a segmental arched relief, a hipped peak rising behind
items.how: builder: base and top rail, balusters every 0.55 m, end piers with spheres, half-disc pediment, hip triangle from the 3DBAG gable top (22.0 m) to the ridge end

items.where: stone shoulder piers with ball finials at both lower corners of the gable
items.how: builder: pier box, cap and sphere on each gable shoulder

items.where: dark brick base: two rows of small sash windows with cream surrounds, a plank door at the centre, a cream cornice at 5 m
items.how: six small windows and a door per gable plus the cornice band; the photographs show a different window count per arm

items.where: Greek cross: four equal gabled arms 14.8 m wide round one crossing under hipped slate roofs (ridge 27.8 m)
items.how: builder: cross-shaped prism to the eaves from the BAG ring, four ridged arms clipped on the valley diagonals, dentil band at the eaves

walls.note: North gable: not in a panorama (market stalls, trees); same composition as the east gable by the cross plan (the RCE photographs show two gables with identical windows and roundel).
West gable, Prinsengracht side: same composition by the cross plan.
South gable above the low flat-roofed annex and the south-west consistory (Hnapel photograph; RCE 20013222): the annex has the cream cornice, small windows and a lower arched door.

items.where: low brick annex with a flat roof at 5.2 m and a cream cornice, wrapping the south arm's foot
items.how: builder: BAG-ring polygon extruded to 5.2 m with a stone cornice box along each edge

walls.note: Consistory lean-to in the south-west angle: arched portal with steps, shuttered sashes, a round oculus over the door, a dormer with the arms cartouche and red shutters (Marcelmulder68 photograph; panoramas 00466 and 00473).

items.where: lean-to with a slate roof between two arms, brick walls 8.7 m high
items.how: builder: ring polygon prism with a fan roof rising to the crossing walls

items.where: round-arched double doors in a cream surround with a flight of low steps, shuttered sash windows either side, round oculus above
items.how: cream surround block, dark door slab, shuttered windows as cream and glass blocks, three steps; the arch head is a flat block and the oculus is omitted

items.where: dormer on the lean-to roof with a cartouche of arms and a red-shuttered window
items.how: stone dormer body with a gable cap and a red shutter block; the cartouche carving is not modelled

walls.note: Bell turret on the crossing (RCE 20013222, 20013236, Hnapel): lead-grey square stage with four clock dials dated 1622, an open lantern with arched bell openings, a domed cap, gilt ball and weathercock.

items.where: dakruiter on the crossing, 27 to 38.8 m: square clock stage, open bell lantern, dome, ball and weathercock
items.how: builder: slate stage with cornice, four dial discs with gilt rings and hands, stone lantern with four dark openings and corner posts, hemispherical dome, gilt ball, spike and cock plate

items.where: gilt-ringed black clock dial on each side of the square stage at about 29 m
items.how: builder: disc, gilt torus ring, hand block on all four sides

walls.note: North-east angle house, BAG 0363100012177303 (bouwjaar 1623; RCE 3923: 'met diagonaal tussen de armen geplaatste dienstwoningen'). Rectified panorama 00017 (2024) and TMX7316010203-001673_pano_0000_002448 (2020, artifacts/landmark-briefs/nkc-0363100012177303/w01-31.alt.jpg); Beeldbank 'Bijgebouw' (2006, a7d03b81). Brick, two storeys, eave 8.5 m (3DBAG front face 8.55-13.95 m above ground), slate hipped roof into the arm walls; was a generic flat-roofed 14 m OSM block before.

items.where: two-storey brick service houses set diagonally in the NE, SE and NW angles of the cross, slate hipped roofs dying into the arm walls, eaves 8.2-8.5 m, lead decks at 13.7-14 m against the church
items.how: builder buildCornerHouses: BAG ring prism to the eave, hipped roof as one plane per eave edge at the 3DBAG slope (46-48 deg) clipped against the others, flat deck where all pass the 3DBAG deck height; cream eave cornice and white frieze

items.where: round-arched portal at the middle of the front: cream stone surround 3.0 m wide, 4.5 m high, dark double doors, two steps
items.how: builder: arch-outline surround with an arched hole, recessed arched door leaf with a centre joint, two stone steps

items.where: round oculus in a cream ring between the portal head and the first-floor sash, centre 5.0 m
items.how: builder: stone torus ring over a dark disc

items.where: white-framed small-pane sashes (three bays per front, two floors); brick relieving arches with cream keystones and springers over the NE ground-floor sashes
items.how: builder sash(): white frame, glass, meeting rail, glazing bars, stone sill; relieving arch as a flush half-annulus in red brick with a stone keystone and two springers

items.where: stone dormer over the door of each corner house: round-headed top carrying an oval cartouche with the arms (red), a small red-framed window
items.how: stone box with a half-disc head, red frame, glass and white cross bar, oval stone cartouche with a red disc for the arms; the arms' crosses and the cartouche scrolls are not carved (0.4 m features)

items.where: white-painted timber shaft 1.6 m square rising from the roof behind the north bay to the church gutter (about 15.3 m), capped, one small dark window
items.how: builder: white box from the roof to 15.3 m with a wider cap and a dark window

items.where: two small wall lanterns either side of the portal at about 3.2 m
items.how: dark box per lantern; no glazing or bracket

walls.note: One-storey annex in front of the east gable, part of BAG 0363100012177303 (3DBAG flat roof 4.0-5.1 m). Panoramas 00556 (2025) and b_20241216_0911_Track34_Sphere_00014 (2024).

items.where: one-storey brick annex with a flat roof and cream cornice wrapping the foot of the east gable
items.how: builder: BAG ring prism to 4.1 m with a lead-coloured flat cap and stone cornices on the exposed fronts

items.where: sashes with dark green panelled shutters and a side door (no. 42)
items.how: builder sash() with dark green shutters either side; stone-framed dark green door

items.where: access ramp with black steel railings along the annex front

skip.note: thin railing bars (40 mm) along a 1 m ramp; invisible at gallery size

walls.note: South-east angle house, BAG 0363100012176942 (bouwjaar 1623), Noordermarkt 45 ('Bijgebouw', Beeldbank 6d9cb29c and 67a7db92, 2006). Front between two one-storey wings that project 4.5 m (3DBAG flat roofs 4.3 and 4.5 m); eave 8.3 m, deck 13.3-14.0 m.

items.where: red double door in a white timber doorcase under two round-headed lights, centre of the front
items.how: builder: white doorcase, red leaves with a white centre joint, two arched glass lights with white half-ring heads

items.where: one-storey brick wings either side of the front, cream cornices, one sash on each exposed face
items.how: builder: BAG ring prisms with flat caps, cornice and a sash per face

items.where: low garden railing and gate in front of the door between the wings

skip.note: a 1.1 m railing of thin bars; at gallery size it reads as nothing and would hide the door

walls.note: North-west angle house, the kosterij, BAG 0363100012176956 (bouwjaar 1623; Beeldbank 'Kosterij (bijgebouw)' 1fcf8de3, 2006, and 020d3bcb, 1989). Chamfered square reaching both gable planes; one-storey entrance block (3DBAG flat 5.8 m), upper storey and dormer set back, eave 8.2 m, deck 13.7 m; taller west wing with a pyramid roof (3DBAG faces 8.2-12.4 m).

items.where: one-storey entrance block across the whole diagonal and north return, cream cornice at 5.8 m, the upper storey 2.5 m behind with two small sashes
items.how: builder: full ring prism to 5.8 m with a flat cap, upper storey prism clipped behind the setback line, hipped roof and dormer on it

items.where: cream stone doorcase with pilasters and an entablature, gridded fanlight over a dark door, small lights either side
items.how: surround slab, two pilaster boxes, entablature box, dark door, glass fanlight with a white 4 x 3 grid; capitals and mouldings are flat

items.where: taller west wing at the Prinsengracht end: large small-pane sashes on two floors on the diagonal and the west return, steep slate pyramid roof
items.how: wing prism to 9.0 m with a 60 deg hipped roof; the wing depth (2.3 m) is read from the photograph, so the roof tops out near 11 m, not the 3DBAG 12.4 m peak
